Parameters for hierarchical cluster data generation

params_hierarchical.Rd

Parameters for hierarchical cluster data generation

Usage

params_hierarchical(
  n_supergroups = 3L,
  n_subclusts = 3L,
  supergroup_spread = 15,
  subcluster_spread = 2,
  point_std = 0.4
)

Arguments

n_supergroups

Integer. Number of top-level groups. Defaults to 3L.

n_subclusts

Integer. Number of subclusters per supergroup. Defaults to 3L.

supergroup_spread

Numeric. Spread of supergroup centres in the ambient space. Defaults to 15.0.

subcluster_spread

Numeric. Spread of subcluster centres around their supergroup centre. Defaults to 2.0.

point_std

Numeric. Within-subcluster Gaussian noise. Defaults to 0.4.

Value

A list of parameters for use with manifold_synthetic_data().
